# Agent Sessions

> Switch AIs. Keep the conversation.

Your history follows you from ChatGPT to Claude to Cursor. Agent Sessions keeps the thread so you never explain it twice.

## Product

- [Home](https://sessions.mcpbox.dev/): landing page
- [How it works](https://sessions.mcpbox.dev/#how): connect ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor, then pick the same thread up in any of them
- [Use cases](https://sessions.mcpbox.dev/#use): switch tools on your own, or hand a session to a teammate
- [Pricing](https://sessions.mcpbox.dev/#pricing): a free tier is listed; Pro pricing is TBD

## More agents

- [Agent Computer](https://computer.mcpbox.dev)
- [Agent Brain](https://brain.mcpbox.dev)
